title: Krishi Fair
subtitle: AI-Powered Agricultural Marketplace
description: A full-stack agricultural marketplace with AI crop advisory, live mandi and weather insights, automated auctions, and image management.
highlights: Context-aware Google Gemini chatbot for crop advisory and pest management
Government Mandi and Weather APIs with caching for live agricultural insights
Node-Cron auction expiry, winner declaration, and idempotent bid processing
Cloudinary multipart uploads with CDN optimization and image transformations

title: Weather Dashboard
subtitle: Real-Time Weather Application
description: A responsive weather dashboard providing live conditions, five-day forecasts, location search, and adaptive day/night weather experiences.
highlights: Browser geolocation, city search, loading states, and error handling
Modular TypeScript components with animated weather-specific UI
